searches.query: Pinned local rg searches for contextual bandit, transfer exponent, margin condition, self-similarity, dyadic bins and perfect trees; inspected the relevant definitions in Holder, Order/Bounds, Set/Operations, Probability/Process/Adapted, Function/FactorsThrough, SimpleGraph/Acyclic, Pow/NNReal and existing integral/conditioning/finite-extrema sources; checked registered p0207 PDF pages 8-10 and 14-16 plus saved ambient/source conventions.
searches.result: Extended nonnegative real powers support square roots retaining infinity, while real log and real powers handle finite positive logarithm arguments and bin scales; a maximum implements both the bias floor and log-plus.

library_audit.gap: The two-branch confidence formula must be assembled with extended-real zero-count behavior and log-plus clamped at one.
